title: Lever escapement
object: Swiss lever watch escapement in plan, with a section through the balance staff and its jewel bearings
idea: Turning stored energy into equal ticks: a clock-driven scheduler, a rate-limited event loop
summary: A balance and hairspring swing at 4 Hz whatever the mainspring does; the escapement only lets the train move when the balance says so. Each beat the fork unlocks a stone, the club tooth pushes the stone and the fork pushes the impulse jewel, then the tooth drops onto the other stone and locks, so the escape wheel advances one tooth every two beats. The diagram marks every impulse on the balance's swing.
usedFor: Horology teaching: lock, unlock, impulse, drop, draw and lift angle
